feature: Expand triage watchlist 4→7 and remove --first-parent from keyword/file_log search
problem: P22.5 expanded shortlist to 20 but triage still cuts at 7 (3+4), creating a dead zone at positions 8-10. GT cases like GROOVY-8298 and SPARK-23059 are stuck in this dead zone. Additionally, search_commits_by_keyword and get_file_history still use --first-parent, missing commits introduced via merged branches. Pickaxe had this fixed in P22 but keyword_grep and file_log were missed.
proposed_solution: Two independent one-liner changes: (1) WATCHLIST_SIZE 4→7 in triage.py, expanding total triage from 7 to 10 (3 must-examine + 7 watchlist). (2) Remove --first-parent from search_commits_by_keyword in git_search.py and get_file_history in git_context.py, matching the P22 pickaxe fix.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: WATCHLIST_SIZE constant in triage.py equals 7
AC2: assign_tiers() with default params produces 3 must_examine + 7 watchlist for a shortlist of >=10
AC3: narrow_candidates() default watchlist_size is 7 (inherited from constant)
AC4: search_commits_by_keyword in git_search.py does NOT contain --first-parent
AC5: get_file_history in git_context.py does NOT contain --first-parent
AC6: search_commits_by_pickaxe (already fixed in P22) still does NOT contain --first-parent
AC7: Docstrings in search_commits_by_keyword and get_file_history no longer reference --first-parent

AC8: All existing tests in tests/test_narrowing.py pass with assertions updated to reflect WATCHLIST_SIZE=7 (specifically: test_watchlist_gets_next4 renamed/updated, tier_rank list extended, and all hardcoded == 4 watchlist assertions changed to == 7)

AC9: SCOPE GUARD — list_recent_commits and list_commits_in_date_range in git_search.py RETAIN --first-parent unchanged (these use linear history intentionally for overview/browsing, unlike keyword search which needs merge traversal)
edge_cases: EC1: Shortlist with fewer than 10 candidates — triage fills what's available without error (e.g., 8 candidates → 3 must-examine + 5 watchlist)
EC2: Shortlist with exactly 3 candidates — all go to must_examine, watchlist is empty
EC3: Shortlist with exactly 10 candidates — all slots filled exactly (3 must-examine + 7 watchlist), no IndexError or off-by-one
verification_method: Run pytest full suite (pytest tests/test_narrowing.py). Verify constants and git args by reading source. Grep git_search.py for --first-parent: should appear in list_recent_commits and list_commits_in_date_range ONLY.
